decisions.text: Remote control should be 'fashionable' (not ugly) to appeal to consumers
Focus on channel and volume buttons (used ~65% of the time); deprioritize audio/screen settings
Do not work with teletext (it has been taken over by the internet)
Not going to work with Ceefax/television page navigation technology
Focus only on television (not video or other platforms)
Target group will be aimed at younger audience (fashion + electronics), though exact demographic (age range) not yet finalized
Voice recognition will NOT be used as a function in the remote control
Price limit for production is 12.5 Euros (for the remote)
Remote will be sold separately (not bundled with TV)
Emphasis will be on simplicity and fashion (usability + functional IR)
Need to investigate whether remote needs a battery (current suspicion: yes), but consider rechargeable option
Will use a simple 'pull-out' or slide-out screen/hatch for hidden/complicated buttons (optional for advanced functions)
